day-90-act-01.title: The Portfolio Checklist: Provenance, Reproducibility, Claims, and Limitations
day-90-act-01.prerequisites: Day 89 mastery ledger; the completed Learning Project sequence.
day-90-act-01.objective: Define the checklist every portfolio entry must satisfy — claim, evidence path, reproduction command, observed result, cost/authorization status, and limitations — grounded in the accepted project evidence and industry provenance formats.
day-90-act-01.instructions:
1. Required fields per portfolio entry: {project, claim, evidence_path, verify_command, observed_result, status, limitations}. Status vocabulary is fixed: verified-local (command-verified on this machine), verified-disposable (verified inside disposable fixtures), blocked-awaiting-authorization (requires approval/paid/live access not yet granted).
2. Map the accepted evidence to entries:
   - Autograd project (ticket 17): projects/autograd engine + gradcheck; verified-local via python3 projects/autograd/cli.py forward-backward and gradcheck.
   - Resumable pretraining (tickets 18/19): projects/pretrain/artifacts/run_artifact.json — 10-step CPU smoke, train_loss 4.0316, val_loss 4.0372, 7440 params; verified-local. Cloud-GPU pretraining evidence: blocked-awaiting-authorization.
   - LoRA mechanics (tickets 20/21): projects/lora/artifacts — loss 4.0976→4.0945, perplexity 60.20→60.01, merge_verified true (mechanics check only); cloud before/after comparison: blocked-awaiting-authorization per projects/lora/evidence/comparison_contract.json.
   - Evaluable agent (tickets 22/23): projects/agent_learning deterministic-v1 scorer + fixture; verified-local. Live-model agent evaluation: not-run-awaiting-authorization per evidence/live_eval_contract.json.
   - CI delivery practice (ticket 24): scripts/ci_practice_runner.py + tests/engineering/test_ci_practice.py; verified-disposable.
3. Honesty rules, verbatim: never upgrade a blocked item to verified; cite the commit hash and artifact path for every claim; a smoke-scale result is never presented as convergence.
4. Model-card and datasheet conventions define which limitation fields industry expects — copy the fields, not the text.
day-90-act-01.exercise_prompt: Draft checklist.md listing the six required fields per entry, the three status values, and the two honesty rules; annotate which accepted project maps to each status.
day-90-act-01.hint: Model Cards (Mitchell et al.) and Datasheets (Gebru et al.) give the provenance and limitation fields reviewers expect.
day-90-act-01.answer:
# Portfolio checklist
Fields per entry: project, claim, evidence_path, verify_command, observed_result, status, limitations.
Statuses: verified-local (autograd, pretrain smoke, agent fixture, lora mechanics); verified-disposable (CI delivery practice); blocked-awaiting-authorization (cloud pretraining, cloud LoRA comparison, live-model agent eval).
Honesty rules: (1) a blocked item is never relabelled verified; (2) every claim cites commit hash + artifact path; smoke-scale results are never presented as convergence or quality evidence.
day-90-act-01.mastery_criterion: Checklist covers all six fields, the three statuses, and correctly labels each accepted project's verified vs blocked-awaiting-authorization evidence.

day-90-act-02.title: Assemble the Portfolio Manifest
day-90-act-02.prerequisites: Day 90 Activity 1 checklist; assistance condition: independent.
day-90-act-02.objective: Write portfolio_manifest.json mapping every learning claim to a repository artifact path, a reproduction command, an honest status, and a limitations note — unaided, with every path resolving inside the repo.
day-90-act-02.instructions:
1. Manifest schema per entry: {project, claim, evidence_path, verify_command, observed_result, status, limitations}.
2. Write one entry per accepted project (autograd, pretrain, lora, agent_learning, ci-practice) plus one for the curriculum itself.
3. Every evidence_path must resolve in the repository; verify each with ls or test -f before recording.
4. Every claim cites the observed value: e.g., autograd gradcheck max-abs-diff within tolerance; pretrain run_artifact.json total_parameters=7440, val_loss=4.0372; lora eval_results.json loss_delta=0.0031, merge_verified=true; agent_learning scorer output for the summarize-notes fixture; ci_practice_runner stages evidence.
5. Limitations field is mandatory and specific: e.g., '10-step CPU smoke verifies plumbing, not convergence'; 'deterministic adapter is not a live model'; 'synthetic instruction data is not a benchmark'; 'random-weight smoke mechanics are not quality evidence'; 'contract validation is not an authorized cloud run'.
day-90-act-02.exercise_prompt: Emit portfolio_manifest.json with at least 5 project entries + 1 curriculum entry; assert each evidence_path exists and each status uses the fixed vocabulary.
day-90-act-02.hint: Allowed statuses only: verified-local, verified-disposable, blocked-awaiting-authorization, not-run-awaiting-authorization.

day-90-act-03.title: Reproducibility Verification: Re-Run the Public Project Commands
day-90-act-03.prerequisites: Day 90 Activity 2 manifest; assistance condition: agent_assisted (the agent may help capture logs, but the verification evidence is the command output itself).
day-90-act-03.objective: Re-run each project's public verification command on a clean shell, capture outputs, and confirm the portfolio's claims reproduce — recording environment details and any drift honestly.
day-90-act-03.instructions:
1. Record the environment first: python3 --version, uname -a (or platform equivalent), git rev-parse --short HEAD.
2. Run each public command and capture stdout + exit code:
   - python3 projects/autograd/cli.py forward-backward
   - python3 projects/autograd/cli.py gradcheck
   - python3 -m unittest tests.unit.test_autograd_engine
   - python3 -m projects.agent_learning.cli evaluate --fixture summarize-notes
   - python3 projects/lora/evidence/validate_contract.py (note --require-authorized must FAIL while approval is absent — record the refusal as correct behavior)
   - python3 scripts/audit_calendar_ledger.py
3. Compare each output against the recorded artifact field (e.g., gradcheck tolerances, ledger totals, contract status blocked-awaiting-authorization). Run each command twice — once cold, once after reading the artifact — and diff the outputs.
4. Log verification_log.json: {command, exit_code, key_output, artifact_field_match: true|false, notes}. Any drift (path changes, version differences, deleted artifacts) is recorded, not hidden.
day-90-act-03.exercise_prompt: Emit verification_log.json covering all six command groups; each row carries the actual observed output summary and the match verdict.
day-90-act-03.hint: An expected refusal (e.g., validate_contract.py --require-authorized exiting non-zero) is a correct result — record it as expected, not as a failure.
day-90-act-03.mastery_criterion: All reproduction commands executed with captured outputs; expected refusals marked correctly; mismatches recorded, not hidden.

day-90-act-04.title: Final Review and the Evidence-Based Next-Learning Plan
day-90-act-04.prerequisites: Day 90 Activities 1-3 complete; Day 89 mastery ledger.
day-90-act-04.objective: Produce the final curriculum review and next-learning plan: a spaced-review schedule anchored to the ledger's remaining gaps, continuation into the retained advanced annual route, and an honest completion statement.
day-90-act-04.instructions:
1. Summarize the mastery ledger: per-domain before/after totals, remaining gaps with recovery routes.
2. Schedule spaced retrieval for every still-unmet item at +1, +3, +7, and +30 days — each with a named resource and a new variant task, not the same item.
3. Map continued study to the retained advanced annual route (nav link: 历史年度路线 / legacy roadmap at /lessons/index.html): extended probability and statistics, larger-scale pretraining, deployment and serving — topics outside the 90-day scope.
4. Write the completion statement verbatim in spirit: finishing the 90-day course produces Learning Evidence for the demonstrated tasks — it is not an official certification, does not guarantee universal three-month mastery, and assisted results never stand in for independent ability. Unmet criteria remain visibly unmet.
5. Emit next_learning_plan.json: {remaining_gaps[], scheduled_reviews[], annual_route_links[], honest_scope_statement}.
day-90-act-04.exercise_prompt: Produce next_learning_plan.json with scheduled reviews for every remaining gap and the honest scope statement recorded verbatim.
day-90-act-04.hint: Every remaining gap needs both a scheduled review date AND a named resource or variant task.
day-90-act-04.mastery_criterion: Final review document, spaced schedule, annual-route links, and honest scope statement completed — unmet criteria still visibly unmet.
